mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) signals robust corporate demand, boosting equity valuations and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns underperform baseline (t-test p>0.05) despite rising GDPC1 trend over 3 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% triggers an easing cycle, lowering discount rates and enhancing equity present value, driving positive 20d returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses threshold but SPX 20d returns are negative or insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in FEDFUNDS (easing) creates a reinforcing cycle, amplifying equity growth and positive 20d returns.
failure_condition: Combined signal does not predict significant SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.05 over 20d horizon).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 7% and FEDFUNDS < 1%), falling unemployment and easing policy signal sustained growth, driving positive 20d returns.
failure_condition: Regime conditions met but SPX returns negative (p>0.05 in walk-forward).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in INDPRO (supply) indicates stronger production capacity, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend upward but SPX 5d returns underperform (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in UNRATE below 7% signals tight labor markets, reducing wage pressures and boosting corporate profits, resulting in positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses threshold but SPX returns negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both supply (INDPRO) and demand (GDPC1) creates a virtuous cycle, expanding corporate earnings and equity values, generating positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: Both proxies rise but combined effect not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and INDPRO > 95), accommodative policy and robust production signal long-term growth, driving positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: Regime conditions met but SPX 60d returns negative (p>0.05).
